entries.en:
Rozol Cattlan has asked you to synthesize for him a component for the Dezul Qualan's aerodynamo─a delicate instrument which will help keep the airship aloft after takeoff. The Ehcatl Nine knotcounter has personally spoken with Templeton and does not believe you will need to bribe the Highwind Skyways representative to gain access to the crafting facilities at the Observatorium. The knotcounter also does not believe a thing Templeton says, so he warns you to be ready to perform some random task for the unappreciative sot.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.

entries.en:
Templeton is every bit as dishonest as advertised, and now you have full access to the Highwind Skyways temporary crafting facilities. Use the materials given to you by Rozol Cattlan and inspected by Templeton to synthesize a high-quality aerodynamo component, and deliver the finished product to the faction.

※In the event that the status Facility Access: Production II wears off or the synthesis ends in failure, you may try again by speaking with Templeton.

entries.en: Another shifty-eyed adventurer here to take advantage of poor Templeton, are we? Well, I'll have you know, I am a veritable rock! Unmoved by the ungentlemanly jostlings of the world's ne'er-do-wells! Unbroken by the pounding pleas of hollow-hearted heels!
entries.fr: Hm ? Vous voulez vous servir de nos installations d'artisanat à titre personnel ? Non mais vous rigolez, il n'y a pas marqué “service de courrier mog”, là !
entries.ja:
施設を貸してほしいと？
……いえいえ、ただでは貸せませんねっ。
会社のモノとはいえ、壊されては私が困りますしっ！

entries.en: Unless, there is something in it for me, of course. A rolling stone gathers no moss, but why would I want moss when I could have things?

entries.fr: Par contre, si vous me rendez un petit service en échange, on pourra sûrement arriver à s'entendre... Qu'en dites-vous, c'est une proposition honnête, n'est-ce pas ?
entries.ja:
……あっ、でもでも、貸さないとは言ってませんよっ！？
私は器の大きい男ですからねっ！
ただしお代として、ひとつ所用を頼まれてもらえますかっ？

entries.en: Present the document to Jocea at the apex of the astroscope tower and return with her signature so that I may know that you did not simply run over to the pub and kill a bell or three. What? Where's the trust? I did not get to where I am today by placing my faith in every vagrant and vagabond that came a-rap-tap-tapping at my door.
entries.fr: Lorsque vous aurez remis le document à Jocea, n'oubliez pas de lui demander une petite signature comme accusé de réception. N'allez pas croire que je ne vous fais pas confiance, c'est le règlement intérieur de la société des Vols Hautvent qui l'exige.

entries.en: Ah, the timetable I requested. I was beginning to wonder when that do-nothing dullard from the Skyways would bring it to me. And why does it not surprise me that he found someone to see to the task for him?
entries.fr: C'est  que j'attendais ! En raison de l'intensification du trafic d'aéronefs, nous devons adapter notre programme d'observation des astres. Grâce à vous, je vais pouvoir m'organiser pour les lunes à venir. Merci beaucoup !

最新の運行計画をお知らせいただいているのですよ。

entries.en: You say he wants my signature as proof of your delivery? Absolutely not! Who knows what he will use it for! ............Not leaving, are you? Very well, then. I shall sign...but with my off hand. And only my initials! Now off with you!

entries.fr: Ah, il vous faut une petite signature ? Il n'y a pas de problème, je comprends tout à fait. Les formalités sont les formalités, n'est-ce pas ? Voilà, c'est fait.

entries.en: If he is dissatisfied with the signature, tell him...tell him...I cut my hand on the parchment and could barely hold the quill and─ Why must I, too, be caught in this pathetic web of deceit!? Off with you and don't come back!
entries.fr: Merci encore de vous être déplacé jusqu'ici pour m'apporter ce document. Dites merci à Templeton de ma part, voulez-vous ?

entries.en: You did, didn't you! And here I was all ready to let you use the facilities anyway! Go on then. Get at it. Just try not to damage anything. A lot of unnecessary paperwork that would be. Ah, and I suppose you shall be wanting these materials returned, as well. Hm? Did I inspect them thoroughly? I don't know. Did it appear that I did? Good then! <wink> <wink>

ささ、ここの設備はご自由にお使いくださいっ！

entries.en: It appears you've completed that contraption of yours. I shall not ask what it is for if you promise to remove it from here at once. It would be simply tragic if one of my supervisors were to walk in and I had to tell them of how you threatened to...er...cut my finger on this parchment and slowly bleed me to death if I didn't allow you access to our equipment. <wink> <wink>
